image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a bakery display case filled with various types of bread and pastries. The foreground features large, dark loaves of rye or pumpernickel bread with textured crusts, alongside lighter-colored rolls and long baguettes in the background. The items are arranged on metal shelving units within a glass-fronted display case. The lighting is warm and artificial, highlighting the textures of the baked goods.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the large dark bread loaf appears slightly 'mushy' or overly smooth in certain patches, lacking the crisp, irregular crumb structure expected of real rye bread. It resembles a generated texture map rather than physical dough.

Some of the smaller rolls in the middle ground appear to fuse slightly into each other or the shelf edge, lacking distinct separation boundaries. This is a subtle sign of AI generation where individual objects blend.
The parallel lines of the baguettes in the background show slight warping and inconsistency in perspective convergence, though it is minor.

selected_experts.reason: To verify if the specific types of bread (rye, baguette, rolls) are taxonomically correct and not hallucinated hybrids.
To detect subtle texture inconsistencies, noise patterns, and lighting artifacts common in AI-generated food photography.
To check for fusion between adjacent bread loaves and ensure they are distinct topological entities resting on the shelf.
To verify the structural integrity of the metal shelves and ensure the depth relationship between rows of bread is physically consistent.

focus_areas: Texture realism of bread crusts (crumb structure vs. smooth blobs)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'mushiness' of the dark bread texture in the foreground. Real rye bread has a very specific cracked, coarse surface. AI often smooths this out. Also, check if the metal shelf edges remain straight and consistent across the depth of field, or if they warp/melt into the bread.
